title: A Space owner can connect their domain in one click through Domain Connect, instead of copying records

source.ref: The one-click method slot in DOMAIN_METHODS (owner ask 2026-10-06: fool-proof domains with one-click installs); white label sites build ADR-1708

detail: FILED 2026-10-06 by owner ask ("I also want one click installs"); RE-SCOPED the same day ("I can't afford Entri ... design something easy and consistent without a monthly service"). THE CONSEQUENCE: a client whose DNS is at GoDaddy, IONOS, Cloudflare, Squarespace or Vercel still copies records by hand (LIVE-743). THE FIX, no paid broker: Frequency's own Domain Connect template (the open standard Entri resells). One static template (apex A and www CNAME from the Vercel config API values; no variables), linted and submitted to github.com/Domain-Connect/Templates, signed with an RSA key (private key in Vercel env, public key as a _dck1 TXT on a Frequency domain), then onboarded with each DNS provider (Cloudflare by email to domain-connect@cloudflare.com; GoDaddy, IONOS and Vercel through their partner contacts). In app: discover support with a _domainconnect TXT lookup and the provider's settings JSON, show a Connect with <provider> button that redirects to the signed synchronous apply URL, and on return let the existing auto re-check confirm it. Every unsupported or not-yet-onboarded provider falls back to the copy-records flow, so the panel never dead-ends. LIFT: M, about 6 files (template JSON, signer, discovery, return route, panel button, tests), no migration, no monthly cost. OWNER STEPS: generate and save the signing key (walked through), add one TXT record, approve the template PR. External wait: provider onboarding, weeks per provider. Probe flips when the method is available.

verify.cmd: node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('lib/sites/domain-methods.ts','utf8');const m=s.match(/key: 'one-click'[\s\S]*?available: (true|false)/);if(!m||m[1]!=='true'){console.error('LIVE-780: one-click domain connect is not available yet (DOMAIN_METHODS one-click.available is false)');process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails today: the one-click method is listed as coming. Passes when it is built and switched on.
